integrity.proof_scope: Analytic spectral-projector derivation and sign certificates cover every integer n>=3 and all real h>=0; rational-matrix checks are supplemental finite tests.

scientific_limitations: Exact claims apply only to completed classical four-stage RK4 for unweighted combinatorial-Laplacian diffusion on crown graphs and the corresponding intact complete bipartite graphs. No internal-stage positivity or general edge-deletion monotonicity is asserted. The smallest crown is a six-cycle already subsumed by a separate cycle classification; the noncycle infinite family starts at n=4. Historical specialized coverage remains possible.
title: A sharp edge-deletion reversal for fourth-order diffusion positivity on crown graphs
